content:
**OPNduck v0.6.0-Beta** 🦆

The biggest update yet for OPNduck, and possibly ever. It might be super buggy: expect bugs and report them.

**New**
• Send to OPNduck: links from your phone and browser
• OPNduck Server and Android companion
• AI runtime, Chat and an optional local model
• Recipes, Colour Grade, Background Remover, Dubbing, Beat Finder
• macOS beta (not attached)

Windows installers untested on real Windows.
